cases.mechanism_detail: The founder SVA in TAF1 intron 32 is associated with aberrant splicing and partial retention of intron 32 proximal to the SVA (including a cryptic-exon transcript TAF1-32i ending 716 bp 5' of the SVA), decreased exon usage distal to it and reduced canonical TAF1 mRNA and protein in patient-derived neural cells; CRISPR excision of the SVA rescued these changes.
cases.quote: This intron retention (IR) coincided with decreased exon usage in proximity to the SVA and an overall reduction in TAF1 expression, both of which were rescued by CRISPR/Cas9-based excision of the SVA.
